status.observed_used: tests only (CPU, tiny random checkpoint); not run on the real weights
status.qualification: unqualified; research capture family, no serving route

license: Apache-2.0 (project); original mlx2 code, no source copied

paths: src/mlx2/runtime/models/glm53_gguf.py (Glm53GGUFModel ordinary layer methods: _hc_in, _kda, _mla, _hc_mid, _mlp, hc_expand, rms)

checkpoint.license: MIT (README.md 'License' section: code and model weights released under the MIT License)
checkpoint.fingerprint: not computed in this change (mlx2.thinking_calibration.artifact_identity runs at family load and reads ~5 MiB a shard; the checkpoint id is Sage-S2.1-Flash@<fingerprint8>)
checkpoint.format: 597 GB bf16, 120 shards; Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration (text: 45 layers = 34 KDA + 11 DSA/MLA, HC4, 3 dense + 42 MoE layers with 288 experts top-8 + 1 shared; 1 MTP layer; vision tower + projectors). Only text tensors of layers 0..44 and the embedding/norm/head are read.

sources.repository: huggingface transformers (read only, installed wheel in the mlx2 .venv)
mechanisms: checkpoint tensor naming (f_a/f_b/dt_bias/A_log under self_attn, hc_{attn,ffn}_{fn,base,scale}, per-expert gate/up/down, split q/k/v conv1d)
forget gate decay_rate = exp(A_log) with the -5 lower bound (GGUF ssm_a convention)
f32 HC mixing and f32 router; expert swiglu clamp (gate max 10, up +-10)
sources.modifications: No code copied. The name map and the two value transforms are expressed in glm5_next.py; Glm5NextTextModel is imported only by the CPU test, as the independent oracle (tiny random checkpoint, max relative logit error 1.5e-6; wrong transforms give 0.15-1.3).

mechanisms: literal-content encoding: break each added-token spelling (longest first) with U+FDD0 U+FDD1 after its first character, escape U+FDD0 as U+FDD0 U+FDD2, encode with a copy of the backend whose normalizer removes the mark
sources.modifications: Re-expressed in _Tok for plain-text encoding (no chat template, no transformers class); the vendor file was read, never imported or executed.

validation: CPU only, MLX2_PREFLIGHT_CPU_ONLY=1, tiny random checkpoint at the real head geometry (hidden 64, 5 layers KDA/KDA/KDA/DSA/KDA, 12 experts): ordinary forward vs transformers Glm5NextTextModel; sweep final logits bitwise equal to the ordinary forward (f32 and bf16 storage, ffn_texts=1); packed FFN within 1e-4; resp/mu vs the unit definition; resume and kill-mid-layer resume equal an uninterrupted run; stacked vs routed experts; reads only the layer's own text tensors; fail-closed geometry. Not run on real weights or on the GPU. Independent review by a fresh Claude subagent (2026-11-16); its findings fixed: capture's expert_budget_gb accepted and enforced (fail-closed resident budget), the reference forward reads experts routed so GPU parity checks the stacked bank, unit oracle moved to transformers forward hooks, vendor literal tokenization, single-pass expert reads; plus a state-dir free-space floor and prefetch_ranges for the CLI read-ahead. Header-only load of the real checkpoint: 45 layers, 14.5 GB stacked experts a MoE layer, 624 GB of layer text tensors.
